title: Eviction help, before and after the cut
subtitle: I Belong in Austin funding, in millions of dollars
source: KXAN; City of Austin Council agenda, item 22
alt: Bar chart from KXAN and the City of Austin's October 22 Council agenda: the I Belong in Austin eviction-prevention program had a $4 million budget until Council trimmed it to $3 million last year; on October 22 Council considers adding $2.25 million to the program's contract.
